9.issue_summary: **Silent Background Transfer**: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
9.evidence: FirebaseAnalytics.setAnalyticsCollectionEnabled(true) is called unconditionally in onCreate(), starting telemetry collection before any privacy policy consent.
9.recommendation: Gate Firebase Analytics initialization behind the has_accepted_privacy_policy flag, similar to Crashlytics.

10.issue_summary: **Silent Background Transfer**: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
10.evidence: FirebaseCrashlytics.getInstance().setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled(true) is called unconditionally in MyApplication.onCreate() (line 35), before the gatekeeper AlertDialog in WelcomeScreen can acquire user consent.
10.recommendation: Remove setCrashlyticsCollectionEnabled(true) from MyApplication.onCreate() and only enable it after the user taps 'I Agree' in the WelcomeScreen.
